blocks.text: Yeh chapter 6 ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath: 10 MCQs, 10 short aur 8 long sawal. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short aur long sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai. Pehle khud hal karein, phir jawab dekhein.

blocks.prompt:
1. Explain the concept of data science and discuss its importance in modern applications.
Data science ka tasawwur samjhayein aur aaj ki applications mein is ki ahmiyat bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Data science woh field hai jo data jama karti, us ka analysis karti aur us se mufeed maloomat nikalti hai. Yeh raw data ko meaningful knowledge mein badalti hai aur bare data ke analysis ke liye tools aur methods use karti hai.

Data science ka workflow (Figure 6.1):
1. Collection: mukhtalif sources se data jama karna.
2. Exploring: data ko saaf (clean) aur tarteeb dena.
3. Modelling: model ko train aur test karna.
4. Decision making: nataij ko samajh kar faisle aur amal; feedback se naya data aur behtari.

Interdisciplinary (kai mazameen ka milap): mathematics (hisaab), statistics (data ka khulasa aur analysis), computer science (tools aur programming), domain knowledge (asal masle ki samajh) aur communication skills (nataij samjhana).

Aaj ki applications mein ahmiyat:
- Faisle facts aur data par hote hain, andaze (guesswork) kam hote hain.
- Aane wale trends ka andaza lagati hai.
- Data mein chhupe trends aur patterns dhoondti hai.
- Business, education aur healthcare mein aam istemal; jadeed technology is par bohat inhisar karti hai.
- Data ko ilm bana kar asal zindagi ke masail hal karti hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Misal: school ke paas har student ki attendance aur test marks ka data hai. Data science is data ko saaf kar ke dekhti hai ke kam attendance wale students ke marks kam aate hain; is ilm se school faisla karta hai ke un students ko pehle se madad di jaye. Yahi raw data se ilm aur ilm se faisla hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. Describe different types of data and explain various data sources and collection methods.
Data ki qismein bayan karein aur data ke sources aur jama karne ke tareeqe samjhayein.
blocks.explanation:
Data raw facts aur values ka majmua hai jis se information banti hai. Yeh numbers, text, images, audio ya video ho sakta hai. Sahi nateeje ke liye data durust aur reliable (bharosemand) hona chahiye.

Data ki qismein:
1. Structured data: tables ya spreadsheets ki tarah rows aur columns mein; samajhna aasan. Misal: mark sheets, databases.
2. Unstructured data: koi fixed format nahi; seedha analysis mushkil, khaas tools chahiye. Misal: emails, images, audio, videos.
Jadeed systems dono qismein use karte hain.

Data ke sources: surveys, interviews, forms, sensors aur online platforms (blogs, social websites waghera).

Jama karne ke tareeqe:
- Manual: insani mehnat se (surveys, interviews, forms bharna).
- Automatic: machines aur software se (sensors, online systems).
- Data real time (usi waqt) ya waqt ke saath jama ho sakta hai.
Tareeqa analysis ke maqsad par munhasir hai; achhe sources aur durust collection se analysis ki quality barhti hai.

Storage aur management: data files, databases ya cloud mein save hota hai; management data ko tarteeb, hifazat aur backup ke zariye mehfooz rakhti hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. Explain the concept of machine learning and describe its different mechanisms, including supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement, and rule-based learning.
Machine learning ka tasawwur aur is ke mechanisms samjhayein: supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement aur rule-based learning.
blocks.explanation:
Machine learning data science ki shaakh hai jis mein system explicit programming ke baghair tajurbe se behtar hota hai. Yeh data mein patterns dekh kar prediction ya faisla karta hai; model bare datasets par train hote hain aur naye data se behtar hote hain. Traditional programming mein programmer fixed qawaid (rules) likhta hai, jabke machine learning yeh rules data se khud seekhti hai aur nayi surat-e-haal ke mutabiq dhal jaati hai.

1. Supervised learning: labelled data (har input ke saath sahi output). System apna jawab sahi jawab se milata hai aur behtar hota hai. Prediction ke liye. Misal: spam email, exam result ka andaza, face recognition, bimari ki pehchan.

2. Unsupervised learning: unlabelled data; koi sahi jawab nahi diya jata. System khud patterns dhoondta hai, milte julte data ke groups (clusters) banata hai aur chhupi banawat dhoondta hai. Misal: customers ke groups, data clustering.

3. Reinforcement learning: system mahol (environment) mein kaam karta hai aur har action par reward ya penalty pata hai. Trial and error se seekhta hai; maqsad zyada se zyada reward. Robotics aur games mein. Misal: robot ka maze seekhna, AlphaGo, self-driving car.

4. Rule-based learning (chapter se bahar; kitab naam leti hai magar bayan nahi karti): system IF-THEN qawaid par chalta hai jo experts likhte hain ya data se seekhe jaate hain, jaise AGAR message mein khaas alfaaz hon TO spam. Faisla samjhana aasan, magar sirf unhi haalaat mein kaam karta hai jo rules mein hon.

Masle ke liye sahi mechanism chunna zaroori hai, kyunke learning ki quality tareeqe par munhasir hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Asaan farq: supervised = ustad jawab bata kar sikhata hai (labelled data); unsupervised = koi jawab nahi, system khud milti julti cheezon ke group banata hai; reinforcement = game ki tarah, sahi kaam par point (reward), ghalat par saza (penalty); rule-based = pehle se likhe AGAR-TO qawaid.

blocks.prompt:
4. Discuss the applications of machine learning in healthcare, business, education, and daily life.
Healthcare, business, education aur rozmarra zindagi mein machine learning ke istemal par baat karein.
blocks.explanation:
Machine learning idaron ko bara data jaldi analyse karne mein madad deti hai; bohat se systems seekhe hue patterns se khud kaam karte hain, insani mehnat aur waqt bachta hai.

1. Healthcare: medical data ka analysis aur bimari ki pehchan (diagnosis), jaise medical images mein cancer cells dhoondna, Alzheimer's ya dementia ki ibtidai alamaat, dil ki bimariyon (cardiovascular) ki tashkhees. Doctor behtar aur waqt par ilaj plan karte hain.

2. Business: customers ka rawaiya samajhna, sales aur market trends ka andaza, inventory (maal) ka intezam. Misal: financial systems mein fraud (dhoka) pakarna, chatbots se customer service, customers ko products suggest karna. Faisle data par hote hain, munafa aur efficiency barhti hai.

3. Education: students ki performance track kar ke grades behtar karna, har student ke mutabiq (personalised) mawad, attendance aur assessment systems ko smart banana; learning ke nataij behtar hote hain.

4. Rozmarra zindagi: mobile mein face recognition, voice assistants, social media par pasand ka content, email mein spam filter, navigation apps ke raaste, videos aur music ki recommendations. Rozana ke kaam aasan aur tez.

blocks.prompt:
5. Explain the steps involved in building a machine learning model, including feature selection, feature engineering, and train-test split.
Machine learning model banane ke qadam samjhayein, jin mein feature selection, feature engineering aur train-test split shamil hon.
blocks.explanation:
Machine learning model wazeh qadmon se banta hai (Figure 6.6). Misal: student ke grade ka andaza.

1. Data jama karna: attendance, quiz marks, assignment scores, study hours, pichle exam ke nataij.
2. Data saaf aur tayyar karna taake learning mein use ho sake.
3. Features aur target chunna:
- Features input values hain; target woh output hai jis ka andaza lagana hai (study hours -> marks).
- Sahi features se learning behtar; faltu features accuracy kam karte hain. Features relevant hon aur target wazeh ho.
4. Feature engineering: data ko behtar banana: features chunna, badalna aur naye banana. Raw data ko cleaning aur scaling (ek paimane par lana) chahiye; misal: naya feature "study hours per day".
5. Train-test split: data ke do hisse: training data model ko patterns sikhata hai, testing data unseen (naye) data par performance check karta hai. Aam taur par 80% training, 20% testing. Is se overfitting (rattne) se bachao hota hai.
6. Model ko training data par train karna (jaise hours studied aur exam score ka linear regression model).
7. Test aur evaluate: model test data ka andaza lagata hai aur error napa jata hai, jaise Mean Squared Error (MSE jitna kam, utna behtar).
8. Behtari: zyada ya behtar data se accuracy barhti hai; phir model naye students ke grade ka andaza lagata hai taake ustad kamzor students ki pehle madad kar saken.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Overfitting ka matlab hai model ne training data ratt liya, magar naye data par ghalat jawab deta hai, jaise student jo sirf pichle paper ke sawal yaad kare aur naye sawal par phans jaye. Isi liye testing ke liye alag data rakha jata hai jo model ne pehle nahi dekha.

blocks.prompt:
6. Describe model evaluation techniques and explain accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score.
Model evaluation ke tareeqe bayan karein aur accuracy, precision, recall aur F1-score samjhayein.
blocks.explanation:
Model evaluation ka matlab hai check karna ke model kitna achha kaam karta hai, us test data par jo training mein use nahi hua. Is se model ki khoobiyan aur kamzoriyan pata chalti hain. Performance metrics woh pemaane hain jin se yeh napa jata hai.

Istilahat: TP = sahi pehchane gaye positive, TN = sahi pehchane gaye negative, FP = ghalti se positive kahe gaye, FN = ghalti se negative kahe gaye.

1. Accuracy: kul predictions mein se kitni sahi (percentage). Error rate is ka ulat. Sirf accuracy kabhi dhoka deti hai, khaas kar unbalanced data mein.
Accuracy = (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN)

2. Precision: jin ko positive kaha un mein se kitne waqai positive; durusti (correctness) par tawajjuh. Zyada precision = kam ghalat alarm.
Precision = TP / (TP + FP)

3. Recall: asal positive cases mein se kitne pakre gaye; mukammal-pan (completeness) par tawajjuh. Zyada recall = kam chhoote hue cases.
Recall = TP / (TP + FN)

4. F1-score: precision aur recall ka tawazun (balance) ek number mein; unbalanced data mein mufeed. Zyada = behtar.
F1 = 2 × (Precision × Recall) / (Precision + Recall)

Misal (kitab ki values TP = 40, TN = 50, FP = 10, FN = 5):
Accuracy = (40 + 50) / 105 = 0.857 (85.7%)
Precision = 40 / 50 = 0.8
Recall = 40 / 45 = 0.8889
F1 = 2 × (0.8 × 0.8889) / (0.8 + 0.8889) = 0.8421

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Spam filter ki misal: precision poochti hai "jo emails spam kahin, un mein se kitni waqai spam thin?" (ghalat alarm kam). Recall poochti hai "tamam asal spam emails mein se kitni pakri gayin?" (koi spam na chhoote). F1-score in dono ka darmiyani number hai. Hisaab: 40 + 50 = 90 sahi, kul 105, to accuracy 90/105 = 0.857.

blocks.prompt:
7. Explain validation in machine learning and discuss how models can be improved using parameter tuning.
Machine learning mein validation samjhayein aur bataiye ke parameter tuning se models kaise behtar kiye ja sakte hain.
blocks.explanation:
Validation se check hota hai ke model naye data par kitna achha kaam karta hai. Yeh training aur testing ke baad model ki reliability (bharosa) pakki karne ke liye hoti hai, model ko data ratne (overfitting) se rokti hai aur munsifana evaluation deti hai. Asal istemal se pehle zaroori hai.

Validation dataset: training aur testing data se alag set jis se performance check hoti hai. Saaf aur durust ho taake asal haalaat dikhaye; model is se seekhta nahi. Overfitting pakarne mein madad deta hai; balanced data se behtar nataij.

Robustness aur reliability: robust (mazboot) model mukhtalif haalaat mein achha chalta hai, data ke noise (shor/ghalat values) ko sambhalta hai aur chhoti tabdeeli se fail nahi hota. Reliable model har baar ek jaisa nateeja deta hai aur bharosa banata hai.

(Hyper)parameter tuning se behtari:
- Model ki settings badalna jo us ke seekhne ka rawaiya control karti hain.
- Mukhtalif values aazmayi jaati hain; validation data rehnumai karta hai.
- Sahi tuning se accuracy barhti aur errors kam hote hain; ghalat tuning se model kamzor.
- Validation ke feedback se kamzor hisse pehchan kar theek kiye jaate hain.

Misal: speaker ki awaaz. Bohat oonchi = awaaz kharab, bohat dheemi = sunai na de, sahi level = saaf. Isi tarah sahi hyperparameter values se model behtar seekhta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Teen data sets ko school se samjhein: training data = class ka sabaq, validation data = ghar ka test jis se ustad teaching ka tareeqa (settings) badalta hai, testing data = aakhri imtihan. Model validation data se seekhta nahi, sirf us se settings sahi ki jaati hain.

blocks.prompt:
8. Discuss predictive modeling and causality, and explain the importance of model interpretation in real-world use cases.
Predictive modeling aur causality par baat karein, aur asal zindagi mein model interpretation ki ahmiyat samjhayein.
blocks.explanation:
Predictive modelling data se aane wale nataij ka andaza lagati hai. Models purane data ke patterns dekh kar batate hain ke aage kya ho sakta hai; predictions probability (imkaan) par hoti hain aur hamesha wajah nahi batatin. Durusti data ki quality aur achhi training par munhasir hai. Misal: business mein market aur sales ka andaza, healthcare mein diagnosis, pichle marks, attendance aur study hours se final grade, purane record se kal ka temperature.

Causality batati hai ke koi waqia kyun hota hai: cause-and-effect ka rishta jis mein ek cheez doosri par seedha asar dalti hai. Sirf data se causality hamesha pata nahi chalti; experiments aksar wajah dhoondte hain. Misal: baqaida parhai se exam behtar; smoking se phephron ki bimari ka khatra.

Model interpretation (yeh lafz chapter mein nahi) ka matlab hai model ke nateeje ko samajhna: kin cheezon ne andaza banaya aur kya woh asal wajah hain ya sirf pattern.
Asal zindagi mein ahmiyat:
- Model wajah jaane baghair bhi sahi andaza laga sakta hai, is liye us ke nateeje ko wajah na samjhein.
- Wajah maloom ho to sahi qadam uthaya jata hai (agar parhai ka waqt waqai grades barhata hai to waqt barhayein).
- Ghalat mafrooze (false assumptions) se bachao aur masle ki gehri samajh.
- Bharosa: doctor, ustad aur business amal se pehle model ka faisla samjha aur check kar sakte hain.

rows: Purane data se andaza ke kya ho sakta hai
Batata hai ke kuch kyun hota hai
Nataij ke andaze (forecasting) par tawajjuh
Cause-and-effect ka rishta dhoondta hai
Wajah jaane baghair bhi durust ho sakta hai
Ek cheez ka doosri par seedha asar dikhata hai
Sales, stock trends, bimari ka khatra, students ki performance
Sahi faislon aur ghalat mafroozon se bachne ke liye

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Misal: garmiyon mein ice cream ki sale aur doobne ke waqiat dono barhte hain. Model ice cream ki sale se doobne ke waqiat ka andaza laga sakta hai (prediction), magar ice cream wajah nahi; asal wajah garmi aur zyada tairaki hai (causality). Interpretation yahi farq samajhna hai taake ghalat faisla (ice cream band karna) na ho.
